text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the VR simulation, you spot Happy 
Meek, trained by Trainer Kiryuin, training 
alongside Godolphin Arabian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, speaking with Trainer Kiryuin 
revealed that she was troubled by Happy 
Meek's growth, which was noticeably slower 
compared to other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Referring to data from past Umamusume, 
Godolphin Barb surmises that she is indeed 
a "late bloomer," just as Trainer Kiryuin 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being a late bloomer, aiming for the 
Classic races that all Umamusume dream of 
was difficult. Trainer Kiryuin felt a 
heavy heart over this, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Happy Meek gives an upbeat response, 
saying she'll do her best at her own pace. 
Trainer Kiryuin vows to support her, 
believing that her day to bloom will come.
